entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: The criminals calling themselves the[n]Phantom Thieves are no more.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: However, I believe that this country's[n]citizens are still living their days in[n]anxiety.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: These scandals only increase our distrust[n]of the current government. As a citizen[n]myself, I am enraged!

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: What does it mean to be a politician with[n]responsibility?

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: Working toward personal gain without[n]consideration of the country is[n]outrageous!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: The election's public notification is[n]tomorrow, but no matter where I go,[n]people are cheering for Shido.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: In order to save this country that has[n]been tainted by villains, social reform[n]is essential!
